publishedfiledetails.title: Wiremod
publishedfiledetails.description:
A collection of entities connectable by data wires, which allows for the creation of advanced contraptions.

This is the STABLE edition of wiremod, where updates progress much slower. If you need bleeding edge, use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3066780663]Wiremod Canary[/url].

Wiremod Landing Page: https://wiremod.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/H8UKY3Y
Github: https://github.com/wiremod

Bug Reports/Suggestions:
https://github.com/wiremod/wire/issues/new/choose

Ultimate Guide to Fixing Wiremod:
